title: What Do GOOD PEOPLE Do // Life's BIG Questions 📱

top_liked.author: @mattirealm
top_liked.text: A "good" person does not ghost out on you, after knowing them 25 years, when nothing huge or weird or disgusting has happened in that friendship.  People don't know what good is.  Dude I love this "goodness is the willingness to take responsibility for shared conditions."  Yeah,…
